summary: Verified profile photo bug fix. Uploaded photo via input-photo, saved via cropper-save-button on DEFAULT Modern template — cv-photo now correctly renders with data:image/jpeg URL in the preview header. Confirmed on all 5 templates (Modern, Klasik, Minimal, Kompakt, Fotoğraflı). remove-photo-button correctly removes cv-photo on Modern; Fotoğraflı falls back to placeholder. localStorage persists personal.photo and after reload (same session) the photo still shows. PDF download succeeds with no JS errors (28KB PDF).

CvPdfDocument.jsx L166: (p.photo || t.showPhoto) with Image only when p.photo — correct.
